title: The oven niche
body:
My Naomi. If you are reading this, you came home, and I am already Home. Don't cry on the dough — it makes it salty. I know what they said about you in Caesarea. I never believed a word. Fear will tell you to hide in this kitchen. Don't.
"There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear." (1 John 4:18)
Open the shutters.
— your Savta

title: Behind the loose brick
body:
Every morning for fifty years I lit that oven in the dark, not knowing if anyone would buy a single loaf. Someone always came.
"It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness." (Lamentations 3:22–23)
The well remembers everything, little one. Go and listen.
— your Savta
